name: shaders-smaa
description: Monorepo for the GLSL and WGSL SMAA (Enhanced Subpixel Morphological Antialiasing) shaders.
author: Damien Seguin (https://github.com/dmnsgn)

scripts.release:glsl: npm exec -w glsl-smaa -- npx snowdev release
scripts.release:wgsl: npm exec -w wgsl-smaa -- npx snowdev release
